problem.patches: bun scripts/prepare-desktop.ts was red: prepare-desktop reverse-checks each patch on its own, so any patch whose post-image is not in the checkout fails. The working tree had moved past three of them.

problem.theme: the Agents window resolved workbench.colorTheme to the stock theme. Two causes: (a) ExtensionEnablementService._isDisabledBySessionsWindow -> canExecuteOnSessionsWindow returns false for any manifest with main/browser, and Catppuccin ships dist/main.cjs next to its themes contribution, so its declarative theme is never registered; (b) the window reads its settings from its own workspace file (agentSessionsWorkspace = agent-sessions.code-workspace), not from the agents profile's settings.json - AGENTS_WINDOW_PROFILE_FLAGS.settings is true, so that profile's settingsResource is the default profile's file and profiles/builtin/agents/settings.json is read by nobody.

change.patches: 0021-caret-agent-home-utility.patch re-cut from the checkout (digest 24df135a6782655e8c8ea03726f7fb629e0df222ae86998acbaa576043ab81a0); new 0028-caret-inline-react-in-client-bundles.patch carries the React inlining; new 0029-caret-agents-no-account-widget.patch takes the account control out of the Agents window title bar; manifest.json lists all three; patches/desktop/README.md documents 0027, 0028, 0029 and the re-cut.
change.bundleRule: the app's workbench bundle is a separate artefact from the Caret extension: node build/next/index.ts bundle --minify, then copy desktop/out-vscode over Contents/Resources/app/out/, then re-run build-caret.ts --package so the app is signed again. Editing desktop sources without that step leaves the app running the previous workbench - which is what hid the rail fix from the user.
change.reCutRule: the preceding patches are applied with git apply --index so the diff is taken against the state the patch is applied to. Without --index, git diff still compares against the base commit, which silently produces a base-relative patch - visible as a conflict on sessions.common.main.ts, which 0005 edits first.
change.theme: apps/macos/src/workbench-mode.ts gains AGENTS_WINDOW_WORKSPACE, AGENTS_WINDOW_SUPPORT_SETTING, themeProvidingExtensionIds() and mergeAgentsWindowWorkspaceSettings(); apps/macos/src/extension.ts gains syncAgentsWindowTheme(), called at activation and on every change to the theme settings. It merges into the Agents window's own workspace file: the theme keys, the user's own extensions.supportAgentsWindow entries, and one entry per extension that provides a selected theme (matched by theme id or picker label), keeping the folder list and every setting already in the document.
change.discardedAttempt: the first implementation wrote the same keys to profiles/builtin/agents/settings.json. The packaged app proved that file is never read (the window kept the stock theme), so the write was retargeted and the file removed.
